recognitionIntervals.voiceRateLowerBound: minimum of the workload-bootstrap lower bound and every workload one-sided Wilson lower bound
recognitionIntervals.voiceLiftLowerBound: minimum of the workload-bootstrap lower bound and every workload Newcombe-style lower bound from simultaneous Wilson intervals

decisionRule: Use the preregistered one-sided 95% upper bound for cost ratios and lower bound for benefit or non-inferiority metrics. Recognition lower bounds are the more conservative of workload-resampling and finite-rater bounds.
statisticalClaim: Conservative release evidence guardrails only; this file does not claim a target power without preregistered effect-size and variance assumptions.
note: A future protocol may replace this plan with a justified power analysis and stricter sample sizes, but protocol v2 never accepts smaller samples.
